title: ToolCallEvent
description: Payload of the analysis.toolCall notification: one observable moment in a live run, pushed from host to renderer as it happens. Where analysis.progress carries the model's own sentence about what it is doing, this carries the mechanical traffic underneath it — which tool, with what arguments, for how long, and what came back. The two are separate methods so that a reviewer's view of the work is not interleaved with a debug log. One flat record with a discriminator rather than a family of shapes, because the contract generator cannot render a definition that references another definition.

sequence.description: One-based and increasing within a run. Notifications carry no ordering guarantee worth relying on, so the renderer appends in sequence order and ignores anything it has already seen.

kind.description: What happened. A tool_started and its tool_finished share a turn and a tool name, in that order.

turn.description: Which round trip to the provider this belongs to, from 1.

toolName.description: The tool being called. Set on tool_started and tool_finished, absent otherwise.

argumentsPreview.description: The arguments the model passed, truncated. Set on tool_started. A preview rather than the whole thing: a model can pass a long regular expression or a fifty-path list, and the live view wants the shape of the call, not its every byte.

resultPreview.description: The beginning of what the tool returned, truncated. Set on tool_finished. Tool results are capped at 48 KiB each and a run may make five hundred calls, so the full text is deliberately not pushed across the bridge or retained; resultBytes says how much there was.

resultBytes.description: Size of the full result in UTF-8 bytes. Set on tool_finished.

durationMs.description: How long the call took, in milliseconds. Set on tool_finished.

isError.description: True when the tool refused or failed. A failed tool call is a result the model corrects, not a failed run, so this is information rather than an alarm.

inputTokens.description: Running total of input tokens for the whole run, carried on every event so the view never has to accumulate.

outputTokens.description: Running total of output tokens for the whole run.

costUsd.description: Running estimated cost in US dollars. Absent when the model has no entry in the price table — unknown is reported as unknown, never as zero.

retryDelayMs.description: How long before the next attempt. Set on retry.

retryAttempt.description: Which attempt is about to be made, from 1. Set on retry.

reasonCode.description: Why a retry was scheduled or a turn failed, as a stable code the renderer translates. Never prose.
